verdict.rationale: Viam's hardware abstraction exposes the same API for every component regardless of brand, and its docs say code keeps working when a camera or motor changes in the config (viam-docs-41, viam-docs-19). The RDK can also run viam-server against a dummy 'fake.json' configuration (viam-gh-2), and Viam 101 needs no hardware (viam-docs-66), so code can target stand-in components and then real ones. However, nothing documents an actual simulator or a sim-to-real workflow, so it is unclear whether 'fake' components amount to simulation. missing for 10: explicit simulation/physics-simulator integration, documented sim-to-real workflow showing identical code on both, hands-on corroboration.
